Hi Daniel,

Thanks for your email. We look forward to welcoming you on 13 November (booking ML-2015, Cabin C2, 13–16 Nov).

Pets: We are dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs per room of any size. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and is never guaranteed at booking [P6]. We've passed your request to the front desk, who will confirm whether an earlier time is possible.

Airport shuttle: Our shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport runs hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM at $35 per person one way. It must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. Please reply with your flight number and arrival time, and our concierge will confirm the booking for all three of you.

The team will confirm the final totals.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge
